question: What does the Checks API take of one neutral check run's annotations: how many in one request, how many in all over updates, the longest message kept whole, and does it keep an annotation on a path outside the pull request's diff, or one with no line?
pass: Written before the run, in issue 1030 at 2026-11-20T18:18Z, nothing having run (trial TA4 of decision 0224's plan): in the canary, on a pull request of the trial's own that changes p73/a.py (canary pull request 132, branch trial/p-73, head 410baec), a workflow with its own GITHUB_TOKEN, granted checks write, makes completed neutral check runs: 1, 50 and 51 annotations; three updates of 50 more to the run of 50, then its annotations listed; a message of 65,536 and of 65,535 ASCII characters, each read back; an annotation on README.md, which the change does not touch; one with no start_line or end_line. The writer is GitHub Actions' App, not the Factory's: the annotation limits are the Checks API's, the same for every App, and this session may not mint the Factory App's token. Each answer was written to a file in the job and redacted there by software-factory's tools.redact_trial at d53baceb before it was uploaded. Pass: each is answered by what GitHub returned and recorded; it fails only if an answer cannot be read. Result: one request takes 50 and refuses 51 whole, 422, 'No more than 50 items are allowed; 51 were supplied.' Updates add 50 at a time: the first and third took the run to 100 and 150, the second answered 404 Not Found, as did the list of the off-diff run's annotations made at once after its create; read again a moment later, the run holds 150 and the off-diff annotation is listed, so a read or an update made within a second of a write may miss it. 150 in all met no limit; three pages listed 100, 50 and none. A message of 65,536 characters is taken, 201, and kept cut to 65,535, with no word of it; 65,535 is kept whole. An annotation on README.md, outside the diff, is kept, with its blob_href at the head. One with no start_line and end_line is refused, 422, '"end_line", "start_line" weren't supplied.' Whether the pull request's page shows the annotation off the diff the API does not say, and is left to a look by the Maintainer (issue 1030). The Factory's own limits (adapters/advice.py: 50 in one request, a message of at most 8,000 characters) sit within each; a Finding with no line cannot be an annotation. Passed.
